༄༅/ /skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rim thar pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ces bya ba bzhugs/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ 'dir skyabs 'gro'i nyams len 'khyer bde zhig 'chad pa la gsum/ skyabs su song ba'i dgos pa dang phan yon/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dang 'gro tshul/ skyabs su song ba'i bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo ni dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro yin pas/ rten 'di thog nas snying bo len pa la thog mar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos par ma zad rang nyid nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gral du tshud pa la'ang de la skyabs su 'gro dgos shing*/ rang gis byas pa'i chos nang ba'i chos su 'gro ba la'ang de la skyabs su 'gro dgos pa yin no/ /phan yon ni nang bar tshud pa/ sdom pa blangs na skye ba/ las sgrib 'dzad pa/ ngan song las thar ba/ tshogs rdzogs pa/ gnod pas tshugs dka' ba/ don 'grub pa/ 'tshang rgya ba sogs kyi phan yon chen po rnams 'byung bar mdo las bshad pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ dkon mchog gsum rjes 'brang dang bcas pa yin gyi/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams la gnas skabs kyi re ba tsam ma gtogs/ phugs kyi skyabs su mi 'dzin te/ 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che rnams kyis gnas skabs kyi re ba 'ga' re bsgrub nus kyang*/ phyi ma'i don bsgrub mi nus pas so/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams skyon zad cing yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas gzhan don byed nus pa dang byed par bzhed pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas skyabs su 'os shing*/ nges bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos kyang skyabs su 'os la de sgrub pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kyang skyabs su 'os pa yin te/ rgyas par ni gzhan du shes dgos so/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul la gnyis/ bsam pa dang*/ cho ga'o/ /dang po la rang nyid gnas skabs kyi nad gdon zhi ba'i ched du bsams te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ ngan song las thar ba'i ched du dmigs te skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/

'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba'i ched du dmigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad ngan song dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba'i ched du dmigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba rnams su yod cing*/ de rnams las snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma khyad par du 'phags so/ /skyabs 'gro'i bsam pa dngos ni/ sdug bsngal de rnams las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog gsum la yod nges snyam du snying thag pa nas re bltos 'cha' ba yin zhing*/ skyid sdug gang byung yang khyed mkhyen snyam du blo lings kyis 'grel dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa cho ga la rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod kyang 'dir 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du byas na/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gsang bde 'jigs sogs yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /yongs bskor mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis/ /spyan drangs padma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde'i dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yongs dag mkhyen gyur ba'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang bstan srung bcas/ /spyan 'dren mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes brjod de rdo rje 'chang la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba dang thub pa'i dbang bo byams 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i skyabs yul rnams dngos su byon nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i mos pa dung dung bya/ skabs 'dir 'dod na ji snyed su dag nas/ byang chub chen por bsngo/ zhes pa'i bar yan lag bdun pa byas kyang chog cing*/ yang na oṃ gu ru sarba buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghi nas sparsha pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod kyang rung*/ de nas rang gi ma sogs sems can thams cad kyis rang gi mtha' bskor bar bsams te byas na phan yon lhag par che bas/

de rnams dang lhan cig mgrin gcig tu/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro bzhi skor gcig dang gsum nas brgya stong gi bar ci 'grub dang mjug tu yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro drug skor yang ci 'grub bya/ de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag cag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las skyob tu gsol/ de'i slad du bdag cag la byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ tshe rabs thams cad du'ang 'bral bar med par rjes su bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de'i tshe skyabs gnas rnams las 'od zer gyi tshogs byung nas rang dang sems can thams cad la 'phog pas las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas dag song snyam du bsam pa dang mthar skyabs yul rnams kyang 'od kyi rnam par rang dang sems can thams cad la thim pas byin gyis brlabs song snyam pa'i mos pa shugs can dung ba zhig bya/ de nas skyabs su song ba'i dge rtsa rnams sems can gyi sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum bya ste sems bskyed pa'ang yin no/ /skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bsdu na de yan gyis chog cing*/ thun du bcad de byas na'ang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /sems bskyed cung rgyas par byed na/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum byas te 'jug sems blangs/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ldan na ci ma rung*/ ldan par bdag gis bya'o/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /bral na ci ma rung bral bar bdag gis bya'o/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /mi bral na ci ma rung ma bral bar bdag gis bya'o/ /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /gnas na ci ma rung*/ gnas par bdag gis bya'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ bsdu na gyur cig ces pa yan chad spyi ltar byas kyang cho ga skyabs 'gro de ltar byed pa ni cho ga dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ spyir 'gro 'dug sogs kyi tshe'ang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa'i bsam pa shugs drag yod na tshig ma brjod kyang skyabs 'gror 'gyur ba'ang yin no/ /gsum pa bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas de nyid bsten cing 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre la phugs kyis skyabs su mi 'dzin/ chos la skyabs su song nas chos tshigs bcad gcig yan chad la gus shing*/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spong*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa la'ang gus shing*/ mu stegs can nam/ de min yang dkon mchog la mi gus pa la snying grogs mi bya zhing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhed pa dang*/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod par bya ba sogs la bslab par bya'o/ /sbyin bdag gi nad gdon zhi ba sogs kyi don du dmigs nas skabs 'gro byas na'ang khyad che zhing*/ mdor na rang gzhan gang gi don du'ang skyabs 'gro nas cung zad re kha bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ sngar ltar byas na'ang legs pa yin no/

/ces pa 'di'ang sngags 'chang dad ldan ngag dbang rdo rje zhes bgyi bas 'di lta bu zhig gyis shig dang kho bos par du brko bar bya'o zhes nan tan du byas nas bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba ste/ 'dis kyang sems can du ma la phan thogs par gyur cig /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rim thar pa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs/ - PAGE 82-- PAGE 79-- PAGE 78-
